final: WITH total_members AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM member), major_counts AS (SELECT ma.major_id, ma.department, COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count FROM major ma JOIN member m ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.major_id, ma.department), shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / NULLIF((SELECT n FROM total_members), 0) AS share FROM major_counts), scored AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS above_department_avg FROM shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, above_department_avg FROM scored WHERE above_department_avg > 0 ORDER BY above_department_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
